name: Infographic, Education & Business Image Prompts
body: # Infographics, education, and business Ten Qwen Image 3.0 prompt recipes. Replace bracketed inputs before generation. All quoted text is exact; no translation is implied unless explicitly requested. Outputs require human review. ## EDU-01 — Rainwater journey ```text Create a 16:9 classroom infographic titled "Where rain goes". Show one house roof, one connected gutter, one covered water barrel and one planted rain garden as four clear stages from left to right. Use blue water arrows from roof to gutter to barrel, then a separate overflow arrow from barrel to garden. Label only "Roof", "Gutter", "Storage", and "Rain garden" beside the correct objects. Use cream background and simple cutaway illustration. Do not show drinking-water use or invent capacity figures. Keep arrows unambiguous and the barrel closed. ``` ## EDU-02 — Urban shade comparison ```text Create a 16:9 teaching diagram comparing two fictional street sections under the same sun angle. The left has no trees; the right has two mature trees shading the sidewalk. Use identical buildings, road width and pedestrians, simple architectural illustration and clear shadow footprints. Label panels "Open sun" and "Tree shade". Add no temperatures, percentages or health outcomes. Keep the sun direction consistent and do not imply that shade removes all heat. Variables: street geometry and approved labels. ``` ## EDU-03 — Seed growth worksheet ```text Create a portrait 3:4 worksheet for children about observing a bean seed. Draw four equally sized boxes containing seed, root emergence, first shoot and two leaves. Leave a ruled observation area beneath each box. Use crisp grayscale line drawings and large lettering. Render only "Watch a seed grow", "1", "2", "3", "4", and "My observations". Keep biological order clear without specifying elapsed days. Do not fill the answer areas or add decorative pseudo-text. Variables: approved plant species and worksheet title. ``` ## EDU-04 — Fraction strip comparison ```text Create a grayscale-friendly 3:4 teaching sheet showing three identical horizontal bars. Divide them into two, four and eight equal segments; shade one, two and four segments respectively. Label the rows "1/2", "2/4", and "4/8"; title the sheet "Same amount, different parts". Align bar beginnings and ends precisely and leave the lower quarter blank for discussion notes. Use clear black outlines and one gray fill. No circles, uneven segments, answer bubbles or additional equations. ``` ## EDU-05 — Monthly service dashboard ```text Create a 16:9 dashboard concept using only [VERIFIED MONTHLY TABLE]. Place the supplied headline metric on the left and a line chart on the right; below, show three labeled supporting figures. Use a white background, charcoal text and one blue series. Render exact dates, units and source note from the table. Preserve missing values as gaps; do not interpolate or invent comparisons. Axes must match supplied scales and show units. Variables: table, metric names, source and period. ``` ## EDU-06 — Three-stage roadmap ```text Create a 16:9 product roadmap using [APPROVED INITIATIVES]. Arrange three equal columns titled "Now", "Next", and "Exploring", with no more than three initiative cards each. Use a clean editorial grid, cream cards and muted blue accents; connect only explicitly supplied dependencies. Include the footer "Planning view, not a release commitment". Do not invent dates, completion status, owners or promises. Keep every initiative in its supplied column. Variables: initiative list and dependency list. ``` ## EDU-07 — Museum route map ```text Use an approved floor plan and [ROOM LABELS] to create a portrait visitor-map concept. Preserve entrances, stairs, lifts, walls and accessible routes exactly; simplify decorative detail only. Highlight one supplied route with a continuous blue line and mark its start and finish. Use a clear legend with supplied symbols and render only approved room names. Do not invent exits, accessibility features or scale. Include "Illustrated guide — verify on site". Variables: plan, route and labels; require venue review before publication. ``` ## EDU-08 — Library service blueprint ```text Create a 16:9 service blueprint for borrowing a library item. Use four columns: "Find", "Reserve", "Collect", "Return"; and three rows: "Reader", "Library", "System". Fill cells only with [APPROVED ACTIONS] and draw arrows only for supplied handoffs. Use restrained blue lines, white cells and large text. Keep customer actions distinct from internal operations. No fabricated turnaround times, personal data or decorative icons replacing actions. Variables: action matrix and verified handoffs. ``` ## EDU-09 — Workshop capacity chart ```text Create a 4:3 information card from this fictional dataset: Monday 8 seats, Tuesday 12 seats, Wednesday 6 seats. Title it "Workshop places available" and draw three horizontal bars on one shared zero-based scale, with exact values at bar ends. Use navy labels and ochre bars on white. Include "Illustrative data" in the footer. Do not convert seats to attendance or percentages, and do not change bar order. Keep the twelve-seat bar twice as long as the six-seat bar. ``` ## EDU-10 — Decision tree teaching card ```text Create a 3:4 decision-tree card for a fictional plant-care lesson using [TEACHER-APPROVED QUESTIONS AND OUTCOMES]. Put one root question at the top, two branch questions beneath and supplied outcomes at the bottom. Use labeled "Yes" and "No" branches, consistent rounded boxes and ample whitespace. Preserve all conditions and stopping points; do not invent watering amounts, diagnoses or species advice. Render only approved text and title. Variables: exact tree, plant context and title; teacher review is required. ``` [Back to the prompt index](./README.md).
description_en: Ten Qwen Image 3.0 recipes for classroom infographics, comparison diagrams and business explainers that keep arrows unambiguous and refuse to invent figures.
description_zh: 十条面向 Qwen Image 3.0 的信息图与教学图配方，用于课堂信息图、对比示意图与商务讲解图，强调箭头语义明确、拒绝臆造数据。
long_en: Recipes describe the stages or panels to draw, where each arrow goes, and the small set of labels to render beside the correct objects, in a flat illustration or cutaway style. The constraints are the interesting part: comparison diagrams must hold buildings, road width, pedestrians and sun angle identical between panels, and every recipe forbids adding temperatures, percentages, capacities or health outcomes the source data does not contain.
long_zh: 每条配方说明要画的阶段或分栏、每条箭头的起止，以及需标注在对应对象旁的少量文字，采用扁平插画或剖面图风格。约束条件是精髓所在：对比类示意图要求两栏之间的建筑、路宽、行人与太阳角度完全一致；每条配方都禁止添加原始数据中并不存在的温度、百分比、容量或健康结论。
sec_note_en: Plain text prompts; no tool access or external calls. They constrain the model against fabricating figures, but a generated diagram is still an illustration — verify any factual content yourself before teaching or publishing from it. Written for Qwen Image 3.0; the repo is curated by the commercial platform bestimage.ai, though these files carry no product placement.
sec_note_zh: 纯文本提示词，不涉及工具调用或外部请求。配方虽已约束模型不得编造数字，但生成的示意图终究只是插画——用于教学或发布前请自行核实其中的事实内容。针对 Qwen Image 3.0 撰写；来源仓库由商业平台 bestimage.ai 维护，这些文件本身无产品植入。
